title: Agricultural Extension RAG Retrieval Dataset
subtitle: A TREC/BEIR-style retrieval benchmark of farmer questions over an agricultural knowledge base
description: Document-retrieval benchmark for RAG systems. Given a smallholder farmer's question, rank the most relevant agricultural-extension documents. Features graded relevance (3/2/1/0), multiple relevant docs per query, and built-in hard negatives. Corpus blends an original synthetic backbone (CC0) with LLM-grounded rewrites of open-access CC-BY CGIAR sources. Leaderboard metric: nDCG@5. See DATACARD.md for full schema, evaluation, licensing, and build details.
